snippet.title: Warhammer 40,000: Speed Freeks - Announcement | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
The WAAAGH is coming to PS5. Warhammer 40,000: Speed Freeks delivers high-speed Ork combat racing, chaotic multiplayer battles, and full cross-play support. Wishlist now and get ready for explosive mayhem later this year.
